name: Machine Preacher Curl
grip: Underhand or the machine's semi-supinated handles, keeping wrists aligned with the forearms.
description: Curl the handles of a preacher machine while the upper arms remain supported on its angled pad.
setup: Select a light stack setting and adjust the seat following the machine's instructions.
Place both upper arms on the pad and align the elbows with the machine's indicated axis.
Grasp the handles without lifting the shoulders or reaching the elbows off the pad.
instructions: Bend the elbows to raise the machine handles toward the shoulders.
Keep the upper arms supported and the torso still.
Stop at the machine's comfortable range without forcing the handles closer.
Lower slowly without snapping the elbows straight or letting the stack drop.
cues: Keep upper arms on the pad.
Let the machine guide the path.
commonMistakes: Lifting the upper arms or chest to finish the curl.
Using a seat setting that misaligns elbows and pivot.
